note: What the website shows for each game's mod: its version and what changed. Edit this by hand when a game file changes; the file dates, sizes and checksums come from catalog.json. Bump the version whenever the online file is replaced.

changes: The online panel opens on ONLINE (room codes) by default.
Co-op for 2 to 4 players through Ruffle Together 1.0.3.4: local co-op added to the game, every PC plays with its normal keys.
One shared view on the players; players 2 to 4 are tinted red, green and blue.
Lock-picks and doors work for every player on the shared screen.
Lobby mode: the launcher's lobby runs the room.
Fixes the levels that would not start outside the web page.
Ruffle Together: plays the game's own Player 1 vs Player 2 hot-seat online with 2-4 players, no netcode in the game (launcher, --coop-keys territory-war).
Network version tw-2: everyone in a room needs this build (older builds are refused with a clear message).
Direct IP mode next to room codes (MODE button; room codes stay the default).
A second match in the same room works: the friends' sticks no longer go to the host.
The turn menu is dimmed while someone else has the turn.
A connection that stops answering is noticed after 15 seconds, with a message, instead of leaving a player waiting.
Direct IP next to room codes: a Mode button in the online panel (room codes stay the default).
Shots fired while the previous arrow still flies stay in sync: same wind changes and arrow-on-arrow deflections on both screens.
The open rooms list shows rooms again
a third player in a Direct room is told the room is full.
Online co-op for up to four players.
Online co-op for up to four players.
Direct IP next to room codes: a second tab connects to a relay on the host's PC.
Guests see the same wall sparks and shrapnel marks as the host.
After the last level the host gets MENU at once; a wrong mod version is turned away with a reason.
A guest's own aim and burner flame answer at once; name tags no longer overlap.
Online co-op for two to four players, taking turns.
Online co-op for up to four players through the campaign, room codes or Direct IP.
